title: Hogwarts Pest Patrol
premise: A Hogwarts containment drill has gone wrong, and the player must drag magical pests off a glowing footprint ward before the infestation breaks the castle's defenses.
interaction_model: single-screen mouse-and-touch drag gameplay where the player grabs nearby magical creatures and pulls them away to clear them
objective: protect ward stability, keep the health meter from collapsing, and capture as many pests as possible
progression: five conceptual Hogwarts worlds expressed through presentation, copy, and escalating native survival pressure: Boot Room Induction, Moving Stair Mischief, Greenhouse Overflow, Forbidden Forest Edge, and Battle of the Clock Tower
theme: Harry Potter magical castle pest containment
mood: playful magical urgency with readable arcade pressure
likely_audience: players who enjoy cleanup and satisfying interaction loops
Harry Potter fans who respond to recognizable Hogwarts spaces and magical props
confidence_notes: High confidence in the core mechanics because the game loop, drag handlers, score updates, and fail state are clearly present in code.
Medium confidence in some presentation interpretation because the source JS is obfuscated, though the functional behavior remains easy to infer.
High confidence that the safest remix path is cosmetic and procedural rather than mechanical.
source_game_summary: Beat Bug Blitz is a one-screen arcade cleanup game where bugs spawn over a giant foot, the player drags them away to clear them, health drains when bugs stay too long, and the run ends when health reaches zero.
remix_prompt_interpretation: Harry Potter should be applied as a Hogwarts magical-pest-containment reskin with strong world progression, magical UI language, and procedural creature/background design while preserving the exact drag-and-clear mechanics.
transform_elements: bugs into magical pests such as Cornish pixies and cursed beetles
foot target area into a footprint ward or containment sigil
stage pulse HUD into ward stability messaging
background and menus into Hogwarts environments with five-world progression
recreation_prompt: Create a mobile-first single-screen arcade game called Hogwarts Pest Patrol inspired by Harry Potter, where the player protects a magical ward by dragging mischievous enchanted pests like Cornish pixies and cursed beetles off a glowing footprint sigil before they destabilize it. Keep the gameplay simple and tactile: pests spawn inside one central play area, the player presses or touches near a pest to grab it, drags it away, and releases to clear it if it has been moved far enough; if not, it snaps back. Uncleared pests should begin damaging a ward stability meter after lingering too long, while successful captures restore some stability and add score. Present the game with start and game-over overlays, a clear top HUD, satisfying particles, and strong mobile readability. Build the visual identity as a Hogwarts containment drill that evolves across five recognizable worlds—Boot Room Induction, Moving Stair Mischief, Greenhouse Overflow, Forbidden Forest Edge, and Battle of the Clock Tower—using procedural magical backgrounds, rune motifs, candlelight, castle silhouettes, and reactive warning glows, without changing the core drag-clear arcade mechanics.
